content:
General
* The task is too easy as a puzzle. Use it for a clash of code instead.

Goal
* Please format 0 and 1 as {{constants}}.

Constraints
* Please change the first constraint to:
1 ≤ length of [[A]], length of [[B]] ≤ 10

Cases
* Please revise Test 6 to expect an output consisting entirely of ones, similar to Validator 6.

* Please revise Test 8 to expect an output containing one or more 1s and starting and ending with one or more 0s, similar to Validator 8.

My comment below still applies.

Thanks.

Please stop creating new puzzles while leaving issues to the older ones unresolved, and stop disregarding previous feedback. Your contributions are flooding the contribution page.

I'd encourage you to focus on quality rather than quantity. While binary logic gates may seem like a good theme for multiple puzzles, the similarity and difficulty don't justify so many submissions as a chapter series or submissions as puzzles instead of clashes.

This problem already exists, and as a clash at that.

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/47766d748d839104aa189cfb7c8d9f99c1e11
Your comment was originally valid. However, the author chose to overwrite the original problem with a new one, which consequently rendered your comment invalid.

Cases
* Please revise Test 6 so that [[B]] contains a 0, [[B]] ≠ 11110111, and the expected output is still 11111111.

Thanks.
